newsitem.title: CANADA: Hurricane sets C$80 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane sets C$80 mln private placement.

text.p: Hurricane Hydrocarbons Ltd said on Monday it agreed to a private placement of special units valued at C$80 million.

Hurricane, which late last year acquired Kazakhstan oil producer Yuzhneftegaz, said the placement included special units convertible into 11 percent senior unsecured notes, due March 2002, and common share purchase warrants.
The underwriting group also had an option to sell an additional C$30 million of units prior to closing, the company said.

Under the deal, each special unit would entitle the holder to acquire a C$1,000 five-year note bearing interest at 11 percent, payable semi annually, and 45 purchase warrants, expiring March 26, 2002, allowing the purchase of class A common shares C$6.25.
Hurricane said proceeds would be used to complete the two final payments of US$30 million each for the Yuzhneftegaz purchase. The balance would be added to working capital.
Underwriters were led by Griffiths McBurney & Partners and included St James Securities Partners, FirstEnergy Capital Corp, Midland Walwyn Capital Inc, and Canaccord Capital Corp.
